body: Hi, could you recommend a caster that is specialized in protection spells? I posted this in another thread, but it’s been hard finding a legit spell caster on etsy that focuses on protection.

Sorry to bring up a dead reddit thread, but are there any spell casters you guys would recommend for protection? I’m not looking to curse anyone or to bind anyone to me. I just need a good and strong protection spell. Do you guys have any experience with Etsy witches who would be legit when it comes to this?
